grid.order: row-major; row 0 = north edge, col 0 = west edge

rock_relief.label: Rock relief (HiRISE 1 m DTM)
rock_relief.method: max−min of the 1 m DTM after removing each 4 m cell's best-fit plane
rock_relief.note: Proxy for boulders and rock outcrops. A 1 m DTM resolves features of a few metres; smaller rocks are not seen.
